accuracy_boundaries: The0.002 criterion applies separately to tested refinement comparisons, not to a rigorous aggregate error bar or all omitted physics.
Both scalar-seeded retained parents are tested; unexcited polarization sectors and nonlinear stability are not certified.
The geometry/background stays at its saved24-function no-emission resolution.
The observer remains the baryon-clock/baryon-rest local finite-k readout; no second-gauge metric re-evolution or past-light-cone sky transfer is added.
Ideal comoving-frequency bands are not instrument responses; the angular monopole is not automatically a homogeneous spectral distortion.
No physical parameter, field content, collision-bank coefficient or acceptance threshold was fitted to repair numerical cancellation.
Source-function derivatives are for the leading isotropic nonrelativistic DC approximation, not a full double-Compton redistribution or anisotropic/polarized emission kernel.
Photon production, BR, matched emitting background and perturbed sources, and visibility transfer remain future physical work.
Existing empirical fits retain their previous authority. This stage adds numerical and analytic progress, not a new empirical preference or derivation of G, alpha or electron mass.
